a1_002: [The moment Sakaguchi opens the door, Aqua holds an image in front of his face.]
a1_003: “Dr. Sakaguchi! Let me borrow you tomorrow!”
a1_006: “Do you always ask for help as though you're borrowing a power drill?”
a1_007: “But what I need really is a very useful pair of hands.”
a1_008: [She places the image on the lightbox.]
a1_009: “I have an eighteen-year-old patient who previously underwent excision of a pelvic cystic lesion. There were no signs of malignancy on pathology, and her recovery went very well.”
a1_013: “Yes, we found it not long into her postoperative follow-up. Ridiculous, isn't it?”
a1_014: [She puts up the latest ultrasound image. A septated cystic shadow has appeared beside the uterus on the right again.]
a1_015: “It looks like an adnexal cyst. But what exactly did you remove last time?”
a1_016: “Benign cystic tissue. Its origin wasn't fully established. At least we can be certain we didn't mistake a normal ovary for a cyst and remove it.”
a1_017: “You want to go back in and look.”
a1_018: “This time I plan to use the existing lower abdominal incision and examine the pelvis and surrounding tissues directly. On imaging it's next to the right adnexa again, but I can't shake the feeling there's more to it.”
a1_019: “You could do it yourself. Why ask me?”
a1_020: “I've thought it through twice already. I need someone to look at it from another angle. Besides—”
a1_021: [An eager look appears on her face, rather at odds with her position as department head.]
a1_022: “Haven't you been getting better and better at gynecological surgery lately? This is the perfect chance to show you some truly beautiful pelvic anatomy!”
a1_023: “...That last part is the real reason you asked me, isn't it?”
a1_025: [Sakaguchi picks up the chart and reviews the imaging reports and previous pathology. The patient's name means nothing in particular to him.]
a1_027: “Lower abdominal discomfort and pain with exercise. She was admitted this morning. I'd like you to examine her with me and help explain tomorrow's preparations.”
a1_029: [Aqua places the two images side by side and studies them for a few seconds. Her easy smile fades.]
a1_030: “The first operation went so beautifully. I don't like recurrences I can't explain.”
a1_031: “Then tomorrow we'll take a good look together.”
a2_001: [Location: A private patient room. Later that morning.]
a2_002: [The spacious room is filled with flowers, imported snacks, and two designer handbags. The girl in bed is happily chatting on her phone. At the knock, she immediately sits up straight.]
a2_004: “Good morning, Chihaya. I've brought someone to introduce—my assistant.”
a2_005: [Sakaguchi follows Aqua into the room. Chihaya looks up, and her smile suddenly disappears.]
a2_007: [Sakaguchi freezes too. The surgical cap, the pale face, the figure fleeing the operating room suddenly overlap in his memory.]
a2_010: “The patient who ran out of the operating room last time.”
a2_013: “Oh, right! You've met! That little incident last time!”
a2_014: “Little incident?! I was scared to death!”
a2_015: “But it all went smoothly in the end, didn't it?”
a2_017: “I only learned today that your name is Chihaya Kuramoto.”
a2_018: “Then could you please remember my name separately from how fast I run?”
a2_020: [Chihaya puffs out her cheeks in annoyance, but soon finds herself looking Sakaguchi over.]
a2_021: “So you'll be there tomorrow too, Dr. Sakaguchi?”
a2_022: “Yes, he's my first assistant. I'll do the cutting, and you two can keep chatting.”
a2_023: “Don't make it sound like we're all meeting for dinner!”
a2_024: [Aqua asks Chihaya to lie flat. After washing her hands and putting on examination gloves, she lifts the pajamas to inspect the healing lower abdominal incision, then palpates the abdomen from both sides.]
a2_025: “The original incision has healed well. Is it tender here?”
a2_026: “Mm... It aches on the right. Gently, Dr. Aqua.”
a2_027: “I need to check that tenderness. Did you start running too soon after your last operation?”
a2_028: “It was only jogging! If I don't move around, I'll forget how to play lacrosse.”
a2_029: “Any sudden worsening of pain, vomiting, or fever recently?”
a2_030: “No. I just want this over with. We had so many plans.”
a2_031: [Aqua picks up the ultrasound probe and applies gel. Chihaya reflexively draws her waist back.]
a2_033: “Here... Yes, there it is. Another septated cystic lesion beside the uterus on the right.”
a2_034: “The outlines of the uterus and ovaries are distinguishable. The lesion may not originate from the adnexa.”
a2_035: “That's exactly why we need to operate again and look.”
a2_036: “...Can't you coax it away with the ultrasound?”
a2_039: [Aqua wipes off the gel and straightens Chihaya's pajamas.]
a2_040: “The plan is to enter through the old lower abdominal incision, completely remove the lesion we can identify this time, and examine the uterus, ovaries, fallopian tubes, and surrounding tissues. We'll send another specimen to pathology.”
a2_042: “Yes. It gives us a clear view, which suits a lesion of uncertain origin like this.”
a2_043: “Can't you use a different way in?”
a2_044: “There are transvaginal procedures in gynecology, but the location of your lesion isn't suitable for that—”
a2_045: “W-wait! I was only asking! Why did such a terrifying option suddenly come up?!”
a2_047: “I know it's ordinary! But I'm the one being operated on!”
a2_048: “I think she was asking whether there's a treatment that doesn't involve another operation.”
a2_049: “Oh. In that case, there's no more suitable option at present.”
a2_051: [Aqua takes out the preoperative information sheet and immediately begins explaining it item by item.]
a2_052: “You'll have an epidural again tomorrow. Dr. Sakaguchi will handle it personally. You'll be awake during surgery, and we won't begin until we've confirmed that the pain block is effective.”
a2_053: “Well... having someone I know do the anesthesia does sound nice.”
a2_054: “Also, between tonight and tomorrow morning you'll have a cleansing enema and hair removal around the incision. Then you'll undress, put on a surgical cap, and once inside we'll catheterize, disinfect, position, and secure you—”
a2_057: “An enema?! Hair removal?! I have to do both of those again?!”
a2_058: “Of course. You've done them before, haven't you?”
a2_061: “You shaved everything off last time. It's finally started growing back... and now you're shaving it again?!”
a2_062: “It's growing quite quickly. That shows you're recovering well.”
a2_063: “This isn't the time to evaluate how fast my hair grows!”
a2_064: “And since we're using the old incision, the preparation is familiar. The nurses will be quick.”
a2_065: “How does the nurses being quick help me?!”
a2_066: “At least we won't have to explain what every step is again.”
a2_067: “You don't understand either, Dr. Sakaguchi! Knowing exactly what each step is makes it scarier!”
a2_068: [Aqua turns the consent form toward her.]
a2_069: “It's all explained here. Ask about anything that worries you, but we can't skip the preparation just because you've had it before.”
a2_072: “Why does every doctor at Hoshimi sound happier than the last when they say these things?!”
a2_074: [Chihaya opens her mouth and finds she has no answer.]
a2_075: “...Darn it. That's actually a good point.”
a2_076: [A brief silence. Chihaya looks down at the healing incision on her abdomen, her voice growing softer.]
a2_077: “Actually... I was really happy after the last operation. I thought I'd never have to go through this again.”
a2_079: “Then not long into follow-up, it grew back. I can't sleep at night thinking about lying on that table again.”
a2_081: “I'll remove as much of the visible lesion as I can and examine its relationship to the adnexa carefully. But I can't give you a definite answer yet about why it returned so quickly.”
a2_082: “I'll be operating with her this time. We'll examine it carefully, not substitute guesswork for a diagnosis.”
a2_084: [Chihaya listens carefully to the risks, confirms that she still wishes to undergo surgery, and completes the consent process. She pats her cheeks as though encouraging herself.]
a2_087: “Tomorrow I absolutely won't run out of the operating room again!”
a2_089: “...I feel like I've heard that somewhere before.”
a2_091: [Aqua smiles and puts away the chart, completely unaware that Chihaya is already regretting what she just said.]
b1_001: [The scene briefly returns to the early morning of surgery. A ward at Hoshimi Hospital.]
b1_002: [It isn't fully light yet, but the wheels of a nursing trolley are already rattling down the corridor.]
b1_003: [The scene changes: the bedside lamp switches on; items are checked off the preparation sheet; after the cleansing enema, Chihaya repeatedly visits the toilet, emerging pale and leaning on the doorframe; the nurse completes hair removal and verification, while Chihaya stares despairingly at the freshly trimmed area.]
b1_005: [Ward nurse Ange Tonegawa cheerfully adds the final check to the preparation sheet.]
b1_009: “Your work may be finished... but my life feels pretty much finished too...”
b1_010: “Hehe, don't say that. It's your second time today. Knowing the routine must help, surely?”
b1_011: “Knowing it is exactly why I was dreaming about enemas last night!!”
b1_012: [The nurse cheerfully confirms fasting status, wristband, and records. Chihaya flops back onto the bed, looking as though she has given up resisting.]
b1_013: [The scene returns to the operating-room preparation area at nine that morning. Following procedure, Chihaya removes all her clothing, and her hair is tucked completely into a patient cap. The nursing staff recheck her identity and hair removal.]
b1_014: [She looks at the fully dressed nurses around her, wearing caps and masks, then down at herself.]
b1_015: “...They haven't even started operating, and I already want to go home.”
b2_002: [The operating-room door opens. Chihaya walks in barefoot. Her pajamas are gone; she wears only a patient cap fully enclosing her hair and a wristband. Nothing like her lively self yesterday, she stares blankly, almost an empty shell brought in to be put on the table.]
b2_003: 【Ren Nanase, wearing a surgical cap and a tied surgical mask, was checking instruments beside the table. On the other side, the circulating nurse was efficiently checking the monitors and organizing the prepared supplies.】
b2_009: “They woke me up a little after five this morning.”
b2_010: “Yes, we have an early schedule today.”
b2_012: “Thorough cleansing means one less worry during surgery.”
b2_013: “Then the shaving... the pubic hair you shaved last time had finally grown back a little... and now it's gone again...”
b2_015: “Why does every one of you treat that as something to celebrate?!”
b2_016: 【The circulating nurse closed her clipboard and chimed in half a beat ahead of Ren. There was a hint of amusement in her eyes above the mask.】
b2_017: 「Every box on the checklist is ticked. The ward team did a great job. We're off to a good start today.」
b2_018: “...You keep praising each other. Why doesn't anyone praise my endurance?”
b2_019: 「I'm praising you! You held up well, Miss Chihaya. But the certificate can wait—we haven't done the anesthesia or catheter yet.」
b2_021: [Chihaya slowly raises her head and looks at the operating table.]
b2_022: [Safety straps, anesthesia supplies, and surgical instruments are already laid out beside it. The surgical light hangs overhead. With hair, noses, and mouths thoroughly covered, the two nurses carry on as though this were an ordinary day at work.]
b2_025: “I've had an enema, been shaved, and taken all my clothes off... How are we still only preparing?”
b2_026: 「Because... the operation itself hasn't started yet.」
b2_027: “I know! You don't have to remind me so cheerfully!!”
b2_028: [Ren lowers the table and pats its surface gently.]
b2_029: “Come on, lie down here. The epidural comes first. Then we'll turn you over, test the block, secure you, catheterize, and disinfect.”
b2_032: “At this point... am I still allowed to run away?”
b2_033: “You mean that thing we agreed about yesterday?”
b2_035: “Hehe, don't worry. Dr. Sakaguchi has already changed into scrubs. He'll be here in a moment.”
b2_036: “And?! Once he's here, it'll be even harder to escape!”
b2_037: 【The circulating nurse reached out to check Chihaya's wristband.】
b2_038: 「Miss Chihaya Kuramoto, give me your hand. Let's check your date of birth one last time—」
b2_039: [Chihaya suddenly looks toward the operating-room door.]
b2_042: [She suddenly turns and bolts toward the door!]
b2_045: [The operating-room door flies open. Wearing only her surgical cap, Chihaya runs out, barefoot and naked.]
b2_047: 「Wait! Don't run so fast—the floor was just mopped. It's slippery!」
b2_048: [Chihaya is already around the corner. She doesn't dare look back, desperately searching for the nearest exit from the surgical department as she runs.]
b2_049: “I'm not doing this a second time! Back to my room, back home, anywhere—!”
b2_050: [At the other end of the corridor, a male doctor in blue-green scrubs, a cap fully covering his hair, and a tie-on mask leans against the wall reviewing a case.]
b2_051: [As Chihaya reaches him, he steps sideways and firmly catches her forearm.]
b2_054: [Caught squarely, she nearly slips on her bare feet. Sakaguchi smoothly steadies her.]
b2_057: [Hearing the familiar voice, Chihaya looks up. The eyes above the mask make her freeze.]
b2_063: “You said you absolutely wouldn't run again rather loudly yesterday.”
b2_065: “And you kept looking at the exit after you went in.”
b2_066: “...You were actually watching for me to escape?!”
b2_067: “Yes. Easier than figuring out this case.”
b2_068: [Chihaya suddenly realizes how she looks. Her eyes widen. Her other hand instinctively tries to cover her body, but she doesn't know where to start.]
b2_070: “I can see that. Don't move around. It's slippery here.”
b2_071: “Why is the slippery floor what you're focusing on?!”
b2_072: 【Ren and the circulating nurse finally caught up. Seeing that Sakaguchi had already stopped Chihaya, they instinctively took positions on either side of her.】
b2_075: “Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi. Waiting here in advance really paid off.”
b2_076: “Check for scrapes first. If she's all right, let's take her back.”
b2_077: “Why are you so practiced at this?! It's already the second time!”
b2_078: 「We've never had the same person run away twice either! Miss Chihaya, you really do keep us on our toes.」
b2_079: “I don't hear anything to be happy about!”
b2_080: [Sakaguchi stops smiling. He confirms that Chihaya hasn't fallen or hurt herself, keeping a hand on her forearm to prevent another dash for the exit.]
b2_081: “Chihaya, you signed the surgical consent form. Under the rules, we have to complete your operation, so you must have surgery today.”
b2_082: [Chihaya stands barefoot on the cold corridor floor, her lips trembling slightly.]
b2_084: “I-I just... When I saw that table, everything from last time came back. And this morning has already been so exhausting...”
b2_085: [Her eyes redden, and her voice grows quiet.]
b2_086: “I know I need it. My body just ran first.”
b2_087: “I understand. Ask if you have any questions about surgery. You'll be awake throughout and can talk to us. But this has already cost us quite a bit of time. Let's get you back onto the table and not leave the team waiting.”
b2_090: “Let's go back, then. You'll catch a chill standing here. And you don't want more people seeing you, do you?”
b2_092: 【Sakaguchi turned her around and led the way. Ren and the circulating nurse stayed close on either side, and the three of them took the naked, barefoot Chihaya straight back into the operating room.】
b2_093: 「Good thing we hadn't opened the catheter kit. Now we don't have to open a fresh one when we get back. You picked quite a moment to run.」
b3_002: [Chihaya finally gets onto the table. She is positioned on her side, knees drawn slightly toward her abdomen and back arched. Ren stands in front of her, supporting her shoulder and knees to help her hold the position.]
b3_003: “Curve your back a little more. Yes, like that.”
b3_004: “...This is so uncomfortable. I feel like a curled-up shrimp.”
b3_005: “This makes the spaces between the vertebrae easier to identify. Once the needle goes in, you mustn't suddenly straighten your back.”
b3_006: “Saying ‘mustn't’ just makes me want to move more!”
b3_007: [Sakaguchi checks the puncture supplies. His mask hides most of his expression.]
b3_008: “Finding the position first. Relax your back, Chihaya.”
b3_010: [The view shifts to Sakaguchi's close-up perspective.]
b3_011: [The young patient's lower back is fully exposed within the working area. Her slender build makes the spinal midline and bony landmarks easy to identify, but her curved posture is stiff, and her spinal muscles tremble slightly with her anxious breathing.]
b3_012: “Slender build, not much subcutaneous tissue. Finding the position shouldn't be difficult... but she's tense all over.”
b3_013: [Through examination gloves, Sakaguchi palpates her lower back with his fingertips. Her skin yields elastically to gentle pressure; the firmness of the underlying bony prominences comes clearly through the gloves. He identifies the spinous processes and the spaces between them in turn.]
b3_015: “Don't move. I'm only finding the position with my hand.”
b3_016: “You can tell where it is just by touching?!”
b3_017: “Roughly. I still need to confirm it further.”
b3_018: “What kind of instruments are doctors' hands, anyway...?”
b3_019: “A narrow waist, but quite firm back muscles, with good elasticity. You exercise regularly?”
b3_020: “Haha! Of course! I'm captain of the lacrosse team! Every day at practice—”
b3_021: [She lifts her chin proudly, then realizes halfway through that she is curled up naked on an operating table, with Sakaguchi's hand still near her lower back.]
b3_022: “...W-wait! Why are you suddenly complimenting my figure?! Right now I'm...!”
b3_023: “Athletes do have good muscle condition. Curve your back a little more. Don't move around.”
b3_024: “I-I know... Still, it's kind of nice to be praised... Ahh, how embarrassing! Pretend you didn't hear that!”
b3_025: [He confirms the position and has the nurse help disinfect her back. Chihaya shivers as the antiseptic touches her skin.]
b3_027: [Sakaguchi changes into sterile gloves and prepares for the puncture.]
b3_028: “Don't suddenly curl up tighter. We're getting ready to insert the needle.”
b3_029: “Already?! At least let me take a breath!”
b3_030: “You can breathe. Just don't change position.”
b3_031: [Sakaguchi administers local anesthesia first, then begins the epidural puncture.]
b3_032: “Ugh... You were just complimenting me. How did we jump straight to needles?!”
b3_033: “I told you we were going to insert it. Hold your position. Don't straighten your back.”
b3_034: “Ugh... My back aches. Is that needle... still in there?”
b3_036: “Aaah! Why did you tell me the truth?!”
b3_037: “You can cry if you need to, Chihaya. Just don't twist your waist yet, okay?”
b3_038: “You sound so gentle, but what you're saying isn't gentle at all!!”
b3_039: [Sakaguchi concentrates on the needle and syringe. Feeling the resistance of the tissues as he advances, he keeps his movements steady. After a distinct stretch of resistance, the pressure at his fingertips suddenly eases.]
b3_041: [He checks the position, then properly places and secures the epidural catheter.]
b3_042: “The puncture is finished. Next we'll give the medication and check the anesthetic effect.”
b3_048: [The anesthetic gradually takes effect. Chihaya's lower abdomen and legs feel heavy, and moving takes more effort than before.]
b3_049: “Ren, get ready to help turn her over.”
b3_050: “Yes. Chihaya, we're going to turn you onto your back.”
b3_051: “Again?! Didn't we finally get me into the right position?”
b3_052: “That was the position for the puncture. Now we need to test the block before we can operate.”
b3_053: [Ren steadies Chihaya's shoulder while Sakaguchi supports her lower back and pelvis. Together, they slowly turn her from her side onto her back.]
b3_054: [Sakaguchi feels her formerly rigid body gradually becoming heavy. Chihaya, meanwhile, is surprised to find that although she tries to help, her legs don't quite obey.]
b3_055: “Wait... Why do my legs feel strange?”
b3_056: “The anesthesia is taking effect. Lie still for now. Don't try to lift your legs yet.”
b3_057: “Even if you let me escape now, I couldn't run, could I?!”
b3_060: [Sakaguchi checks the monitoring values, then picks up a disposable needle for sensory testing.]
b3_061: “Now we'll test the anesthetized area. First I'll show you what a normal pinprick feels like somewhere that isn't numb.”
b3_062: [He lightly touches an unblocked area on Chihaya's forearm, letting her remember the normal sharp sensation.]
b3_063: “Ah! Sharp! I know, that's a needle!”
b3_065: [The tip lightly touches the corresponding area of her lower abdomen without breaking the skin.]
b3_066: “...Huh? Something's touching me, but it isn't sharp.”
b3_070: “Same. Am I supposed to say I can feel it or I can't?”
b3_071: “Just tell me honestly. There's no sharp pain now, right? Don't keep quiet out of embarrassment, or you may scream with pain when we make the incision.”
b3_073: “...There really isn't any sharp pain now.”
b3_074: [Sakaguchi tests adjacent areas, confirming that the level and extent of the block on both sides adequately cover the planned incision.]
b3_075: “...How many times are you going to poke me?!”
b3_076: “We have to confirm enough coverage. You don't want to find out something still hurts only when we cut the skin, do you?”
b3_079: “I can't even argue with you this time...”
b3_080: [After finishing the test, Sakaguchi records the anesthesia findings and looks up at Ren.]
b3_081: “The block is adequate. Let the circulating nurse continue preparing her. I'll scrub in.”
b3_083: “I'm getting ready to operate. I'll be back shortly and stay with you until the operation is over.”
b3_084: “...Why has everything you've said since this morning been about getting to that final cut?”
b3_086: “...I really can't communicate with any of you anymore.”
b3_087: [Sakaguchi leaves the table and heads for the scrub area.]
b4_001: 【The circulating nurse came to the operating table. Her scrubs, mask and cap were neatly in place, and she held a checklist in one hand. She spoke briskly while keeping a close eye on Chihaya's reactions.】
b4_002: 「All right, I'll take over from here. The anesthesia's done, so the rest will be quick—and I mean it this time.」
b4_003: “...Every time someone says ‘quick,’ it never actually is.”
b4_004: 「Here's the order: catheter, arm positioning, safety straps, skin prep, and finally draping. One thing at a time.」
b4_005: “...Couldn't you list a couple fewer things at a time?!”
b4_006: 「Wouldn't you jump even more if I touched you without warning?」
b4_007: “That's a fair point... But why do I have to go through so many steps...?”
b4_008: 【The circulating nurse checked the catheter supplies and the anesthesia status.】
b4_009: 「We'll be operating in the pelvis, so your bladder has to be empty. First item: inserting a urinary catheter.」
b4_010: “...Um, since I'm anesthetized, can I pretend I don't know?”
b4_011: 「Sure. You close your eyes, and I'll handle it. I'll still let you know when I need you to cooperate.」
b4_012: “Don't you think... it's embarrassing to be awake listening to someone catheterize you?”
b4_013: 「Of course it's embarrassing. We do this every day, so we're practiced at it. We'll try to put you through as little trouble as possible.」
b4_014: “What does you doing it every day have to do with me being embarrassed?!”
b4_015: 【The circulating nurse inserted the urinary catheter using sterile technique and secured it carefully, making sure the tubing was not compressed. Chihaya stared at the ceiling, her flushed expression turning into one of resignation.】
b4_017: 「There we go. You cooperated really well.」
b4_018: “Good thing I'm anesthetized. I hardly felt anything. Otherwise...”
b4_019: 「Without anesthesia, it might sting a little. See? This part was an easy one today.」
b4_020: “Don't say it like you actually know what it feels like!!”
b4_021: 「Next item. Come on, move both arms out a little.」
b4_022: “Wait, don't just move casually on to the next item!”
b4_023: 【The circulating nurse adjusted both upper limbs, checked pressure points and fastened the safety straps to prevent slipping during surgery.】
b4_024: “Hey... This counts as tying me up, doesn't it?”
b4_025: 「It's called safety positioning. Your arms can't suddenly slip off during surgery, and you can't sit up out of nowhere and give us all a fright.」
b4_026: “I think you're just stopping me from escaping a third time.”
b4_027: 「You've already had the anesthesia. How are you planning to run now? I don't want to chase you a third time!」
b4_029: 【The circulating nurse picked up the skin-preparation supplies and checked the old lower abdominal incision and the planned operative field.】
b4_030: 「Next, skin prep on your lower abdomen. It'll be cold—I'm warning you now, so don't twist away.」
b4_032: [Antiseptic is applied over the abdomen, around the incision, and across adjacent prepared areas. Chihaya feels coolness and light contact, but can hardly muster the strength to adjust her position.]
b4_033: “So cold... Even colder than the ultrasound gel...”
b4_034: 「Bear with me. Almost done. Today's incision-preparation area is clearly defined, which makes this part go smoothly.」
b4_035: “...Why are you praising how convenient your work is again?”
b4_036: 「Of course I'm happy when the work goes smoothly. Apart from your little run just now, everything with you has gone very well.」
b4_037: 【The circulating nurse carefully checked the prepared skin and its boundaries, then stepped back to recheck both safety straps and the tubing.】
b4_038: 「Checklist: catheter in place, positioning secured, skin prep complete. All confirmed.」
b4_039: “...Is that an achievement we're supposed to applaud?”
b4_040: 「It's important to us. When the preparation's done well, the surgeon can start with confidence. That's my job.」
b4_041: “So it all comes back to cutting me open!!”
b4_042: [The operating-room door opens. Aqua and Sakaguchi have completed their surgical scrub and approach the table in sterile gowns and gloves. Ren has scrubbed too and stands at the instrument table.]
b4_043: [To Chihaya, their hair, mouths, noses, bodies, and hands are all thoroughly covered. She alone remains unable to move as freely as they do.]
b4_046: 「All done. The patient's stable, and I've checked the catheter and restraints too.」
b4_047: “Pass me the sterile drapes. We're ready to drape.”
b4_048: 【From the nonsterile side, the circulating nurse helped pass the sterile draping supplies. Ren and the scrubbed surgical team unfolded the drapes in sequence. Only the planned lower abdominal incision site remained exposed through the opening; the rest was covered by sterile drapes. By simply looking up, Chihaya could see the masked Aqua and Sakaguchi leaning down to prepare, as well as their instrument exchanges with Ren.】
b4_049: “...Why do I feel like you've wrapped me up as a package?”
b4_050: “This keeps everything sterile. We'll cover the surgical area appropriately, but you can see the doctors. Ask them directly if there's anything you want to know.”
b4_051: “I don't want to look! I just feel... You're all dressed, and I'm the only one lying here...”
b4_052: [Watching Aqua and Sakaguchi arrange instruments above her abdomen with sterile-gloved hands, she cannot finish the sentence.]
b4_053: “Don't adjust your position yourself from now on. Tell us if anything is uncomfortable.”
b4_057: [Sakaguchi pauses, seemingly deciding that this isn't among the anesthesia parameters requiring immediate attention.]
b5_001: 【The surgical light moved directly over the operative field. The circulating nurse checked the monitors and tubing at the head end; Aqua took the surgeon's position, Sakaguchi stood on the assistant's side, and Ren readied the instruments.】
b5_003: [The team verifies the patient's name, surgical site, procedure, completed anesthesia, and necessary preparations, item by item.]
b5_004: “Patient: Chihaya Kuramoto. Excision of a pelvic cystic lesion through the lower abdomen, with exploration as necessary.”
b5_005: “Imaging and records confirmed. Epidural block adequately tested, satisfactory coverage bilaterally.”
b5_006: 「Identity matches the wristband. Allergies, catheter and positioning all checked. Vital signs stable.」
b5_008: “...You were talking about me just now, right?”
b5_010: “I'm right here! Why does it sound like you're discussing a piece of equipment?!”
b5_011: “Because we have to make these checks before the incision. We do this every day.”
b5_012: “Stop trying to reassure me with ‘we do this every day’!”
b5_016: [The handoff makes a faint metallic sound. Chihaya watches the scalpel pass into Aqua's hand, her body suddenly stiffening.]
b5_019: “Couldn't you phrase it a little more delicately?!”
b5_022: [Aqua lines up with the old lower abdominal incision.]
b5_024: [The blade enters the skin steadily along the old scar.]
b5_027: “...No. I know you touched me, but... it doesn't feel like being cut.”
b5_029: “You cut into me and then say ‘good’?! Doesn't something sound wrong there?!”
b5_030: “It means the anesthesia is working well. Next we'll enter the abdominal cavity layer by layer.”
b5_032: “We've only cut the skin. There's still subcutaneous tissue and the abdominal wall beneath it.”
b5_033: “Could you stop announcing every layer so clearly?!”
b5_034: [Sakaguchi helps control bleeding and expose the incision. Aqua separates the subcutaneous tissue and identifies the fascial layers.]
b5_035: “The tissue around the previous incision has healed well. A little scar adhesion here... Sakaguchi, give me the retractor.”
b5_038: [Chihaya watches Sakaguchi look down and hold the retractor steadily, while a dull pulling pressure rises deep in her abdomen.]
b5_041: “Are you... really opening my stomach right now?”
b5_042: “Yes. We're almost into the abdominal cavity.”
b5_043: “And somehow I'm still here talking to you normally...”
b6_001: [Aqua carefully separates the tissue around the old incision and enters the abdominal cavity once she has confirmed it is safe. The operative field gradually opens beneath the surgical light.]
b6_002: “Peritoneum open. Fewer adhesions here than I expected... Good.”
b6_003: “Retract the right side first. Let me locate the normal adnexa.”
b6_004: “Right. Expose the uterus first. Nanase, a longer retractor.”
b6_006: “...Wait. What exactly are you pulling apart now?”
b6_007: “The abdominal wall and surrounding tissue. So we can see the pelvis clearly.”
b6_008: “You make it sound so ordinary! That's my body!”
b6_009: “Of course it's your body. Why else would we be so careful?”
b6_011: [Across the table, Aqua is already carefully identifying the boundary between the right ovary and the cystic lesion.]
b6_012: “The right ovary is here. Normal color and blood supply. The cyst wall is beside it, but there doesn't seem to be continuous ovarian tissue.”
b6_013: “The last pathology had no normal ovarian components. At least that matches what we're seeing today.”
b6_014: “Yes. Start separating along the plane between the normal tissue and the cyst wall.”
b6_017: “I'm starting to regret not choosing general anesthesia...”
b6_018: “You confirmed before surgery that you wanted to stay awake. We've also verified the anesthesia.”
b6_019: “I didn't imagine you'd be discussing my ovaries while cutting into me!”
b6_020: [With delicate movements, Aqua dissects the thin-walled cystic tissue. Sakaguchi helps expose it and suctions a small amount of fluid.]
b6_021: “Very close to the fallopian tube here... but the boundary is clear. Sakaguchi, lift a little.”
b6_025: 「Miss Chihaya, what's bothering you? Tell me.」
b6_026: “It's not cutting... It's like someone's pulling inside me, and my stomach feels strange...”
b6_027: 【The circulating nurse quickly checked the monitoring data.】
b6_028: 「Blood pressure is down a little. Dr. Sakaguchi, Miss Chihaya reports significant discomfort from the traction.」
b6_031: 【Traction stopped immediately. The circulating nurse followed the agreed perioperative plan and continued observing, while Sakaguchi confirmed that Chihaya had no sharp pain or other danger signs.】
b6_033: “...Much better. That was really strange. The surface didn't hurt, but it felt like someone was tugging inside.”
b6_034: “The epidural blocks pain at the incision, but traction on deeper tissue can still be uncomfortable. Tell us whenever you feel it.”
b6_035: “Honestly, I don't even know what I'm supposed to be afraid of anymore...”
b6_036: “Don't worry about all that. My job is identifying tissue, Sakaguchi's is helping me expose it, and yours is not moving suddenly.”
b6_037: “...So everyone has a job, and mine is just lying here getting cut open?!”
b6_039: “Please don't give me an outstanding patient award!!”
b6_040: [After a brief pause, surgery resumes. Aqua carefully dissects along the outside of the thin-walled lesion. Sakaguchi adjusts the angle to avoid pulling on the normal ovary or its blood supply.]
b6_041: “The tissue planes are visible here. But the lesion is closely adherent to the loose pelvic tissue.”
b6_042: “Right. That's what puzzles me. It looks so close to the adnexa, yet there's no connection showing it grew from the ovary.”
b6_043: “Clear the planes we can establish first. Let's not damage normal structures chasing a theory.”
b6_046: [Listening to them as though they were solving a difficult exam question together, Chihaya finally cannot help asking.]
b6_048: “No intraoperative complications. We still haven't fully established where the lesion originated, but the dissection is going smoothly.”
b6_050: “We have a very clear view, and the normal adnexa are unharmed. Don't frighten yourself.”
b6_051: “I'd probably have been happier to hear that before entering the operating room...”
b6_052: [Aqua precisely controls a small amount of oozing and continues dissecting along the outer cyst wall.]
b6_053: “Good... Just this last bit. A little more. Hold steady, Sakaguchi.”
b6_056: [The cystic tissue is removed intact from the currently identifiable lesion and placed in a specimen container.]
b6_058: “Yes. We've removed the cystic lesion we could see this time.”
b6_059: “Then... we're finished?! Can I get off the table?!”
b6_060: “We still need to inspect the field, control bleeding, irrigate, and close the abdomen.”
b6_062: “You don't want to go back to your room like this.”
b6_064: [Aqua continues examining the uterus and both adnexa, looking increasingly pleased.]
b6_065: “Good. Smooth uterine surface, beautiful shape. Both ovaries and fallopian tubes are normal too.”
b6_066: “No lesion continuous with the cyst. Good adnexal blood supply, no obvious involvement.”
b6_067: “Wow... A beautiful eighteen-year-old uterus, just as you'd expect!”
b6_068: [Seeing Aqua's delighted expression, Chihaya cannot help crying out from the table.]
b6_071: “I know! But look, it really is beautiful!”
b6_072: “Please don't critique my uterus in front of me! I-I've never even seen it!”
b6_073: “Hehe, would you like to sit up and have a look?”
b6_074: “Aaaah! No!! You're still operating on me, aren't you?!”
b6_075: “Doctor! Please don't make jokes like that to a patient during surgery!”
b6_076: “All right, I'm joking. But a healthy uterus really is worth admiring. Especially one this young, with such clear surrounding tissue planes—”
b6_080: [Aqua carefully explores the operative area again, confirming that no obvious cystic tissue remains. Yet she pauses briefly at one spot.]
b6_082: “Yes. The uterus and adnexa are intact, yet the lesion has appeared beside them twice in a row.”
b6_083: “We checked the surrounding area and found no other visible cystic cavities. The last pathology didn't identify a definite origin either.”
b6_084: “We'll compare this specimen with the last one side by side. Follow-up mustn't be missed.”
b6_085: [She puts her puzzlement aside and turns back to the field.]
b6_087: “Dr. Aqua! Were you whispering about something just now?!”
b6_088: “No danger during the operation. We're still investigating why it recurred.”
b6_089: “...Will I really get better this time?”
b6_090: [Aqua does not immediately make one of her usual confident declarations.]
b6_091: “We've dealt with all the abnormal tissue we can see. The final answer still depends on pathology and follow-up. For now, let's finish the operation properly.”
b6_093: 【Sakaguchi assisted with closing the abdominal wall in layers. Aqua checked the sutures, Ren passed instruments precisely, and the circulating nurse continued checking the monitoring and intraoperative records.】
b6_094: “Fascia closed. Subcutaneous tissue... good. Skin closure.”
b6_095: “Every layer you announce makes me feel like I've been taken apart and put back together...”
b6_096: “That's not entirely wrong. But we carefully suture everything according to its original anatomical layers.”
b6_097: “Ren... Why are you so scary today too...?”
b6_098: [Suturing is complete. Instrument and gauze counts are correct, and a dressing is placed over the incision.]
b6_099: “All right, finished. The operation went smoothly.”
b6_100: [For two seconds, the table is quiet. Chihaya watches Aqua finally move both hands away from the operative field.]
b6_102: “Really. We're getting ready to take you to recovery.”
b6_105: “I never want to set foot in an operating room again...”
b6_106: 「Well done, Miss Chihaya! Congratulations on clearing stage two—though we'll have to deduct a few points for that escape in the middle.」
b6_107: “Don't make surgery sound like a video game!!”
b6_108: [As planned, the nurses undo the straps, organize the catheters and sheets, and prepare for postoperative transfer.]
b6_109: “It really did go more smoothly than last time, though.”
b6_110: “How?! I ran naked out of the operating room this morning!”
b6_111: “Medically, it went smoothly. Running out isn't part of the surgical procedure.”
b6_113: [Exhausted and annoyed, she still lets out a laugh—then immediately presses a careful hand over her freshly sutured lower abdomen.]
b6_114: “Ow, ow, ow... No, I absolutely can't laugh anymore today...”
b6_115: [Chihaya is taken to recovery. Aqua accepts the specimen record and looks down once more at the still-unexplained case.]
c1_001: [Location: Chihaya's room. The morning after surgery.]
c1_002: [Chihaya reclines against her pillows. Flowers, snacks, and magazines fill the room again, but she looks pale and keeps holding her lower abdomen whenever she moves to sit up.]
c1_003: [A knock at the door. Aqua and Sakaguchi enter.]
c1_005: “Good morning! How are you feeling today?”
c1_006: “...I finally believe yesterday wasn't a nightmare.”
c1_008: “Yes! Getting out of bed hurts, coughing hurts, laughing too hard hurts. And where you put the needle in my back is sore.”
c1_009: “Some incisional pain at this stage isn't unusual. Are the painkillers helping? Any fever, unusual bleeding, or abdominal pain that's getting worse?”
c1_010: “It's a little better after the medicine. No fever. It's just... every movement reminds me you really did open me up yesterday.”
c1_012: [Aqua examines the area around the abdominal incision and the dressing, while Sakaguchi reviews the vital signs and postoperative nursing records.]
c1_013: “Ah! That hurts! Don't press so hard!”
c1_014: “I need to check for abnormal tenderness here. All right, just a moment.”
c1_015: “...You opened it up yesterday. Why do you have to poke it today?!”
c1_016: “Because you've had surgery, it's even more important to check your recovery.”
c1_017: “...Hoshimi's doctors are really good at crushing patients with perfectly correct statements.”
c1_018: [The examination finished, Aqua removes and puts away her gloves, looking satisfied.]
c1_019: “You're recovering well, and the wound looks good. Get out of bed for some gentle activity, but don't push yourself into playing lacrosse.”
c1_020: “Even going to the bathroom feels like climbing a mountain. How would I have the energy to play?”
c1_024: “That thing... You got it all this time, didn't you?”
c1_026: “We removed all the abnormal cystic tissue we could identify in yesterday's operative field. We carefully checked the surrounding area and found no obvious remnants. Your uterus and both adnexa are healthy too.”
c1_027: “...You don't need to call my uterus beautiful again!”
c1_029: “But we still can't fully explain why it recurred so quickly. We'll compare the specimen with your previous pathology. You mustn't miss the ultrasound follow-up in six weeks either.”
c1_031: [Chihaya looks down at her abdomen, then raises her face.]
c1_032: “...Okay. I'll come. I don't want a third morning like yesterday.”
c1_033: “Good! We don't want you to have a third operation either.”
c1_034: “...With that huge smile, Dr. Aqua, I find that hard to believe.”
c1_035: [A young woman's lively voice comes from outside.]
c1_036: “Is the examination finished in there? Or do I need to take a number first?”
c1_038: [The door opens. Mizuho Shite enters carrying flowers and a large bag of magazines. Her tasteful clothes and shrewd expression immediately suggest a wealthy upbringing and a mind of her own.]
c1_039: “You're hopeless. Didn't you say it was just a little operation? Why do you look like you've been run over?”
c1_040: “It wasn't little! They actually opened my stomach!”
c1_041: “I know. Don't shout so loudly. Doesn't your incision hurt?”
c1_042: [Despite her sharp tongue, Mizuho first puts the flowers down and adjusts Chihaya's pillow.]
c1_043: “Honestly. You were texting so energetically last night, I thought you were already well enough to go shopping downstairs.”
c1_044: “The doctors all said it went smoothly.”
c1_045: “Hm. You also said a very handsome doctor stayed with you during surgery. Several times.”
c1_049: “Ryuji Sakaguchi. I was the first assistant yesterday.”
c1_050: “I'm Aqua Mizuki, head of gynecology and her surgeon.”
c1_051: “Oh, so you're Dr. Aqua. She mentioned you too. Said you were too beautiful to be a doctor.”
c1_054: “That came second. First was ‘the doctor is super pretty.’”
c1_055: “Mizuho! Don't read out all my messages!”
c1_056: [Mizuho looks Sakaguchi up and down, narrowing her eyes with a smile.]
c1_058: “...Thank you. Let her rest quietly for now.”
c1_059: “See? Doesn't he look like one of those handsome doctors on TV?”
c1_060: “Oh, please. Have you been hospitalized so long that your taste has turned into a hospital brochure?”
c1_061: [Chihaya cannot help laughing, then immediately clutches her lower abdomen in pain.]
c1_062: “Ow, ow, ow... Stop it! You're not allowed to make me laugh today!”
c1_064: [Mizuho sits beside the bed. After a while, she lowers her voice.]
c1_065: “Seriously... When can you come back to class?”
c1_066: “The doctors say they still need to monitor my recovery. As for school... taking a year off is already decided.”
c1_067: [Mizuho pouts, as though she already knew but is unhappy all the same.]
c1_068: “We'd already planned the school in New York and where we'd live. We promised to study business there together after graduation.”
c1_069: “You can go first. I'll catch up a year later.”
c1_070: “Then you'd have to call me your senior. Absolutely not.”
c1_072: [They glare at each other, then suddenly laugh together. Chihaya draws another pained breath as her incision protests.]
c1_073: “...Actually, I'd like to take a year off too, and wait for you.”
c1_076: “Of course I do! But your family...”
c1_077: “Won't allow it. They say I'm perfectly healthy, so why should I delay my education for a friend?”
c1_079: “That's how they are. Everything needs a ‘proper reason.’”
c1_080: [She speaks as though complaining about something trivial, but rolls up the magazine on her lap, then flattens it again.]
c1_081: “Sometimes I wish I could find a perfectly legitimate reason to take a year off too.”
c1_082: “Wait! You're not jealous of my operation, are you?!”
c1_083: “I'm jealous that you have a valid reason to stay here, not that your stomach got cut open.”
c1_084: “...Hey, why does that still sound strange?”
c1_085: “Don't overthink it. I just want us to go together.”
c1_086: [Chihaya falls quiet for a moment, then reaches out and takes Mizuho's hand.]
c1_088: “All right, buy me the most expensive meal when you're better. Don't think a thank-you gets you off the hook.”
c1_091: [Their usual liveliness returns. Mizuho looks around at the flowers and magazines, then out at the lovely hospital grounds.]
c1_092: “Still, your room really is nice. Yesterday you said staying at Hoshimi was a great experience. I thought you were joking.”
c1_094: “...You just said the morning enema nearly killed you, and they shaved you again.”
c1_096: “And stripping naked and getting onto the table surrounded by fully covered doctors and nurses?”
c1_098: “And you said you ran out of the operating room?”
c1_100: “An accident? This was your second time!”
c1_102: “Then what exactly was so great about it?!”
c1_103: [As though she has been waiting for this question, Chihaya excitedly sits a little straighter, then has to slow down as the movement pulls at her incision.]
c1_104: “Because the doctors and nurses are amazing! And beautiful! Watching everyone work together in the operating room is unbelievably cool!”
c1_105: “...You mean while you were lying there getting cut open?”
c1_106: “Yes! You know, I really felt like I was in Team Medical Dragon!”
c1_108: “Exactly that feeling! The operation hurt and the preparations were hell, but once the real surgery began, the whole team was like something from a TV drama!”
c1_110: “Dr. Sakaguchi is as handsome as Dr. Asada! I'd already escaped into the corridor yesterday, but he'd actually been waiting there to catch me. Then he gave me the epidural himself!”
c1_111: “Huh? Wait, when he caught you, weren't you—”
c1_113: [Mizuho's shoulders shake with laughter, while Chihaya buries her embarrassed face in the blanket.]
c1_114: “And Dr. Aqua is like Dr. Kato, clever and beautiful. Her whole presence changes when she stands beside the surgical field!”
c1_116: “And Nurse Nanase! Just like Miki! So skilled, passing instruments while still answering my questions!”
c1_117: [A soft knock comes at the door. Ren happens to arrive to check Chihaya's postoperative condition and pauses at the last remark.]
c1_119: “Ren! Yes, you! I was so frightened on that table yesterday, but not one of you panicked!”
c1_120: “Hehe, because the operation was going smoothly.”
c1_121: “That's exactly what I mean! The scarier something seems to me, the more ordinary it is to you!”
c1_122: “...I think I understand. Liking the people here doesn't mean liking all the preparations they put you through.”
c1_124: “Though I still think you're a little strange.”
c1_126: “Mm, I get what you mean. But I prefer Doctor-X to Team Medical Dragon.”
c1_128: “Isn't that ‘I never fail’ attitude cool? And she's so decisive.”
c1_130: “Dr. Mizuki, you can't use lines from TV dramas as preoperative promises.”
c1_131: “I know! I just think it's cool!”
c1_132: “Hehe, are all Hoshimi doctors this entertaining?”
c1_133: “That's why I like it here! I just absolutely don't want a third trip to the operating table!”
c1_134: [Mizuho glances at Sakaguchi, then smiles openly again.]
c1_135: “But Chihaya was right about one thing. Dr. Sakaguchi really is handsome.”
c1_137: “And reliable. He even managed to catch a repeat runaway like you.”
c1_139: “What if I like Dr. Sakaguchi too?”
c1_140: “Huh? Then our taste matches again, doesn't it?”
c1_141: “What's wrong with that? Beautiful things should be admired together.”
c1_142: [The two laugh without the slightest concern that Sakaguchi is standing right there.]
c1_143: “...Ladies, today's rounds aren't a casting call.”
c1_145: “Thank you for your work, Dr. Asada.”
c1_146: “Then Dr. Kato is heading back to gynecology too!”
c1_148: [The four dissolve into laughter. Once again, Chihaya laughs too hard, clutches her lower abdomen, and cries out.]
c1_149: “Ahh! It's all your fault! My incision hurts again!”
c1_150: “That's why I told you not to get excited.”
c1_151: “...As if any of you intended to let me have some peace!”
c1_152: [Sakaguchi finishes the postoperative orders and leaves with Aqua. Mizuho stays beside the bed, chatting with Chihaya.]
c2_001: [Location: A corridor at Hoshimi Hospital. Before noon.]
c2_002: [Sakaguchi walks along carrying the chart. In the bright corridor, a young woman doctor hurries past with an imaging trolley, while nurses prepare for the next operation. The bustle resembles a familiar TV scene.]
c2_004: [He remembers Chihaya's excited expression as she described the operating room.]
c2_005: “A patient who thinks preoperative preparation is hell, yet says staying here is wonderful...”
c2_006: [Several young staff members pass him, laughing. He looks up and around.]
c2_008: [Young, beautiful doctors, exceptionally skilled nurses, bright, spotless corridors, and one operation after another.]
c2_009: “...This hospital really does feel a little like a Japanese medical drama.”
c2_011: “...Wait. Why am I starting to think that way too?”
c2_012: [He looks down at the chart in his hands, shakes his head, and keeps walking.]
